correctness.rationale: An independently written exact check reconstructed the Fano non-line triple graph and all 196009 augmented faces, verified 97999 unit Morse pairs and acyclicity of the full directed Hasse graph, and summed the signed paths in topological order. In the stated bases the two columns of d7 are (-1,1,1,1,-1,1,0,0) and its negative; d8 has column (1,1). Hence ker d7=im d8, d8 is injective, and the primitive first column gives a free quotient of rank seven in degree six only. I exhibited an isomorphism to the harmonic-duad graph on P^1(F_7); the 336 explicit projective actions remain distinct on pairs, and distance-preserving backtracking finds exactly 336 graph automorphisms. For representatives of all nine actual conjugacy classes I summed augmented fixed-simplex contributions directly using inversion parity, giving the claimed vector (7,-1,-1,1,-1,-1,0,1,1) with the stated sizes. Lefschetz equals the top trace since degree six is even. Directly enumerated Fano collineations meet the classes in counts (1,21,0,56,42,0,48,0,0); the full group and Fano subgroup squared sums are 336 and 168, while both unweighted-over-elements trace sums vanish. These prove absolute irreducibility, also for the PSL restriction, and absence of fixed homology. The character agrees with the published table. The frozen verifier was inspected but not executed.
residual_risks: Exact finite enumeration and discrete Morse cancellation, not a formal proof assistant certificate. No classification of the integral equivariant lattice follows.
